name: Iron Coral
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
I want to try Furen Longbeard's new techniques on my own piece of armor.  And because you helped Furen and he helped me, you're welcome to the armor after I make it!

To finish the piece, I need a special coral, searing coral.  It grows in only one place--along the coast south of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

Bring me enough searing coral and I'll get right to work on the armor.  And hurry, adventurer.  I'm so eager to get started it's making my toes twist!
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 loads of Searing Coral to Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
That's the stuff! Well done! Now let me get this smelted and hammered so I can apply Furen's technique with my own and then we can see what happens!

Oh my, oh my! I just know the armor will be very very very tough!
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello hello, adventurer! Do you have the searing coral? I can't wait to get to work!

quests.name: The Rethban Gauntlet
quests.objectiveText: Enter the Rethban Caverns, reach the first fork, and return to Yorus Barleybrew within the time allowed. You must not die and release your spirit.

quests.name: The Shieldsmith
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Cask of Scalder to Furen Longbeard.

quests.name: Fire Hardened Mail
quests.objectiveText: Gather the materials Furen Longbeard requires, and bring them to him in Stormwind.

quests.name: Klockmort Spannerspan
quests.objectiveText: Bring Furen's Notes to Klockmort Spannerspan.

quests.name: Iron Coral
quests.objectiveText: Bring 20 loads of Searing Coral to Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.
